proj_nwf_8817.name: Northwind Freight
proj_nwf_8817.summary: Regional freight brokerage, 60 contract drivers, ~400 loads/month. Dispatch runs on a whiteboard and a single spreadsheet. Wants load matching, in-transit visibility, and proof-of-delivery capture that starts the driver payment clock.
open_questions: Shipper-facing visibility: portal at launch, or notifications only with the portal staged to a later phase?
Offer sequence tiers: how many drivers in the first tier, and how long before a load opens wider?
Offline behaviour: which actions must complete with no connectivity and sync later?
decided: Driver reliability scoring is deferred to a later phase at the client's request.
Hours-of-service tracking is explicitly out of scope; drivers remain responsible as contractors.
QuickBooks stays in place and is not replaced.
proj_nwf_8817.next_action: Answer the three open questions, then request a revised scope of work.

proj_hvd_4402.name: Harborview Dental
proj_hvd_4402.summary: Six-location dental group. Patient intake is paper on clipboards, re-keyed by front desk. Wants digital intake, insurance pre-verification, and recall scheduling.
decided: Practice management system stays; integration is read-plus-write on appointments only.
Clinical charting is out of scope.
proj_hvd_4402.next_action: Third-party cost estimate, then assemble the proposal.

feedback_log.note: Recall scheduling is the priority, intake can be phase two.

proj_kes_2231.name: Kestrel Outdoor Co
proj_kes_2231.summary: Outdoor gear retailer moving from a third-party marketplace to a direct storefront with a guided-fit product finder.
decided: Marketplace listings continue in parallel through launch.
proj_kes_2231.next_action: Proposal draft is complete and waiting on human approval. See the approval gate.
